q19248.en: The sign shown warns of a narrowing on the right side of the carriageway.

explain.short: The right-hand line bends inwards: the road gets narrower on the right.
explain.rule: The sign warns that the carriageway (road for vehicles) gets narrower on the RIGHT side. Slow down and keep to the free part of the road.
explain.trap: 'strettoia' means a narrow point of the road; 'sulla destra' matches the bending line.

sceneParams.caption: Road narrows on the right ahead

q19249.en: The sign shown warns of a narrowing caused by a fixed obstacle on the right side.

explain.short: The narrowing on the right is often caused by something fixed, such as a wall: this is what the sign announces.
explain.rule: The sign warns that the carriageway (road for vehicles) gets narrower on the RIGHT side. Slow down and keep to the free part of the road.
explain.trap: 'ostacolo fisso' (fixed obstacle) is the typical cause of this narrowing, so the statement is right.

sceneParams.caption: Narrowing from a fixed obstacle on the right

q19250.en: The sign shown warns of a dangerous narrowing on the right side of the carriageway.

explain.short: It is a danger sign, and the danger is the road getting narrower on the right.
explain.rule: The sign warns that the carriageway (road for vehicles) gets narrower on the RIGHT side. Slow down and keep to the free part of the road.
explain.trap: 'restringimento' is just another word for 'strettoia' (narrowing).

sceneParams.caption: Dangerous narrowing on the right

q19251.en: The sign shown warns that the carriageway gets narrower because of low walls or another obstacle on the right side.

explain.short: Low walls or other obstacles on the right reduce the width of the road: that is the narrowing on the right.
explain.rule: The sign warns that the carriageway (road for vehicles) gets narrower on the RIGHT side. Slow down and keep to the free part of the road.
explain.trap: 'muretti' (low walls) is just an example of an obstacle; the key idea is 'lato destro'.

sceneParams.caption: Walls on the right make the road narrower

q19252.en: The sign shown can also be found on a two-way road.

explain.short: A road can get narrower on any kind of road, so the sign can also stand on two-way roads.
explain.rule: The sign warns that the carriageway (road for vehicles) gets narrower on the RIGHT side. Slow down and keep to the free part of the road.
explain.trap: 'anche' (also) makes it a possibility, not an obligation: that is correct.

sceneParams.caption: Can be on two-way roads too

q19253.en: The sign shown, if it has a yellow background, is placed where roadworks reduce the width of the carriageway.

explain.short: Danger signs with a yellow background are temporary and are used for roadworks (cantiere).
explain.rule: The sign warns that the carriageway (road for vehicles) gets narrower on the RIGHT side. Slow down and keep to the free part of the road.
explain.trap: 'fondo giallo' (yellow background) always means a temporary sign for roadworks.

sceneParams.caption: Yellow background = roadworks narrowing

q19254.en: The sign shown indicates the end of two-way traffic.

explain.short: The sign warns of a narrowing on the right; it says nothing about two-way traffic ending.
explain.rule: The sign warns that the carriageway (road for vehicles) gets narrower on the RIGHT side. Slow down and keep to the free part of the road.
explain.trap: 'fine del doppio senso' (end of two-way traffic) is a different sign; this one shows lines narrowing.

sceneParams.caption: Narrowing on the right, not end of two-way

q19255.en: The sign shown requires you to give way to vehicles coming from the opposite direction.

explain.short: This is only a danger sign: it warns of a narrowing and gives no rule about who goes first.
explain.rule: The sign warns that the carriageway (road for vehicles) gets narrower on the RIGHT side. Slow down and keep to the free part of the road.
explain.trap: 'obbliga a dare la precedenza' (requires giving way) belongs to a different, round sign for narrow passages.

sceneParams.caption: Danger warning only, no give-way rule

q19256.en: The sign shown allows driving in parallel lines (queues).

explain.short: The road gets narrower, so there is less space: it does not allow parallel lines of traffic.
explain.rule: The sign warns that the carriageway (road for vehicles) gets narrower on the RIGHT side. Slow down and keep to the free part of the road.
explain.trap: 'marcia per file parallele' (parallel queues) is the opposite idea: the road is narrowing.

sceneParams.caption: Road narrows: no parallel queues

q19257.en: The sign shown tells you to arrange yourselves in two lines.

explain.short: The two black lines are the road edges getting closer, not two lanes or two lines of cars.
explain.rule: The sign warns that the carriageway (road for vehicles) gets narrower on the RIGHT side. Slow down and keep to the free part of the road.
explain.trap: 'disporsi su due file' (form two lines) misreads the two black lines of the picture.

sceneParams.caption: The lines are road edges, not two queues

q19258.en: The sign shown warns of a merge from the right.

explain.short: A merge (confluenza) has its own sign with a side road joining; this one shows the road narrowing on the right.
explain.rule: The sign warns that the carriageway (road for vehicles) gets narrower on the RIGHT side. Slow down and keep to the free part of the road.
explain.trap: 'confluenza' (merge of another road) is a different danger sign.

sceneParams.caption: Narrowing on the right, not a merge

q19259.en: The sign shown warns of the start of a one-way road.

explain.short: One-way roads are shown with blue information signs; this red triangle warns of a narrowing.
explain.rule: The sign warns that the carriageway (road for vehicles) gets narrower on the RIGHT side. Slow down and keep to the free part of the road.
explain.trap: 'senso unico' (one-way) has nothing to do with this narrowing sign.

sceneParams.caption: Narrowing, not start of one-way

q19260.en: The sign shown warns of a movable bridge.

explain.short: The picture shows a bridge deck lifting over water: a movable bridge ahead.
explain.rule: The sign warns of a movable bridge that can open or lift for boats. You must stop only when its red lights are flashing.
explain.trap: 'ponte mobile' (movable bridge) is the exact name of this sign.

sceneParams.caption: Movable bridge ahead

q19261.en: The sign shown is a danger sign.

explain.short: It is a triangle with a red border: the shape of danger signs.
explain.rule: The sign warns of a movable bridge that can open or lift for boats. You must stop only when its red lights are flashing.
explain.trap: 'segnale di pericolo' (danger sign): every red-edged triangle pointing up is one.

sceneParams.caption: Red-edged triangle = danger sign

q19262.en: The sign shown can be completed with a panel showing the operating times of a movable bridge.

explain.short: A panel under the sign can tell you when the bridge is opened for boats.
explain.rule: The sign warns of a movable bridge that can open or lift for boats. You must stop only when its red lights are flashing.
explain.trap: 'può essere integrato' (can be completed) means a panel may be added, which is correct.

sceneParams.caption: Panel may show the bridge's opening times

q19263.en: After the sign shown we may find a device with flashing red lights.

explain.short: Movable bridges often have flashing red lights that switch on when the bridge is about to open.
explain.rule: The sign warns of a movable bridge that can open or lift for boats. You must stop only when its red lights are flashing.
explain.trap: 'possiamo trovare' (we may find) is a possibility, and it is correct here.

sceneParams.caption: Flashing red lights may follow

q19264.en: The sign shown requires you to stop if the flashing red lights are working.

explain.short: Flashing red lights mean the bridge is opening: you must stop and wait.
explain.rule: The sign warns of a movable bridge that can open or lift for boats. You must stop only when its red lights are flashing.
explain.trap: 'se sono in funzione' (if they are on) is the condition: you stop only then.

sceneParams.caption: Stop when the red lights flash

q19265.en: The sign shown can be completed with the distance panel with three red bars.

explain.short: Like other important danger signs, it can be followed by distance panels with red bars that show how close the bridge is.
explain.rule: The sign warns of a movable bridge that can open or lift for boats. You must stop only when its red lights are flashing.
explain.trap: 'pannello distanziometrico' (distance panel) is an extra panel, so 'può' (can) makes it right.

sceneParams.caption: Distance panel with three red bars allowed

q19266.en: The sign shown warns of a port area.

explain.short: The picture shows a bridge that lifts for boats, not a port.
explain.rule: The sign warns of a movable bridge that can open or lift for boats. You must stop only when its red lights are flashing.
explain.trap: 'area portuale' (port area) is wrong: water in the picture does not mean a port.

sceneParams.caption: Movable bridge, not a port area

q19267.en: The sign shown requires you to stop before crossing the bridge.

explain.short: You do not always stop: you stop only if the red lights are flashing or the bridge is open.
explain.rule: The sign warns of a movable bridge that can open or lift for boats. You must stop only when its red lights are flashing.
explain.trap: 'obbliga ad arrestarsi' (requires stopping) is too strong; a danger sign only warns.

sceneParams.caption: Stop only if red lights flash

q19268.en: The sign shown warns of a bridge with a steep slope.

explain.short: The lifted part of the bridge shows that it opens, not that it is steep.
explain.rule: The sign warns of a movable bridge that can open or lift for boats. You must stop only when its red lights are flashing.
explain.trap: 'forte pendenza' (steep slope) misreads the raised deck in the picture.

sceneParams.caption: Bridge that opens, not a steep bridge

q19269.en: The sign shown requires you to give way to vehicles coming from the opposite direction.

explain.short: This danger sign only warns of a movable bridge; it gives no rule about who goes first.
explain.rule: The sign warns of a movable bridge that can open or lift for boats. You must stop only when its red lights are flashing.
explain.trap: 'impone di dare la precedenza' (requires giving way) belongs to other signs.

sceneParams.caption: Warning only, no give-way rule

q19270.en: The sign shown forbids overtaking if placed on the access road to a port area.

explain.short: It is a danger sign for a movable bridge: it does not forbid overtaking and has nothing to do with ports.
explain.rule: The sign warns of a movable bridge that can open or lift for boats. You must stop only when its red lights are flashing.
explain.trap: 'vieta il sorpasso' (forbids overtaking) is a prohibition; a danger sign does not forbid.

sceneParams.caption: Movable bridge warning, no overtaking ban

q19271.en: The sign shown warns of a level crossing with barriers.

explain.short: A level crossing with barriers has its own sign with a fence; this one shows a bridge over water.
explain.rule: The sign warns of a movable bridge that can open or lift for boats. You must stop only when its red lights are flashing.
explain.trap: 'passaggio a livello' (level crossing, where road crosses railway) is a different sign.

sceneParams.caption: Movable bridge, not a level crossing

q19272.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road that can become dangerous in particular weather conditions specified in the additional panels.

explain.short: The road becomes slippery in some weather; a panel under the sign can say which one, such as rain or ice.
explain.rule: The sign warns that the road surface can become slippery and the tyres can lose grip. Slow down and avoid sudden manoeuvres.
explain.trap: 'pannelli integrativi' (additional panels) give the weather; the statement is correct.

sceneParams.caption: Slippery in the weather shown on the panel

q19273.en: The sign shown warns of a road whose surface can become particularly slippery.

explain.short: The car with wavy tracks means a slippery road surface.
explain.rule: The sign warns that the road surface can become slippery and the tyres can lose grip. Slow down and avoid sudden manoeuvres.
explain.trap: 'sdrucciolevole' (slippery) is the exact name of the sign.

sceneParams.caption: Slippery road surface ahead

q19274.en: Sign (A), together with panel (B), warns of a road with a particularly slippery surface in case of rain.

explain.short: Panel B shows a rain cloud: the road is slippery when it rains.
explain.rule: The sign warns that the road surface can become slippery and the tyres can lose grip. Slow down and avoid sudden manoeuvres.
explain.trap: 'in caso di pioggia' (in case of rain) matches the rain cloud on panel B.

sceneParams.caption: Panel with cloud: slippery when raining

q19275.en: Sign (A), if combined with panel (B), warns of a stretch of road where, in particular weather conditions, ice is likely.

explain.short: Panel B shows snowflakes: in cold weather there may be ice on the road.
explain.rule: The sign warns that the road surface can become slippery and the tyres can lose grip. Slow down and avoid sudden manoeuvres.
explain.trap: 'ghiaccio' (ice) matches the snowflakes on panel B.

sceneParams.caption: Panel with snowflakes: ice likely

q19276.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road where tyre grip can decrease.

explain.short: On a slippery road the tyres hold the road less: grip goes down.
explain.rule: The sign warns that the road surface can become slippery and the tyres can lose grip. Slow down and avoid sudden manoeuvres.
explain.trap: 'diminuire l'aderenza' (grip decreases) is right; 'aumenta' would be wrong.

sceneParams.caption: Tyre grip can decrease

q19277.en: The sign shown requires you to drive at a moderate speed and avoid sudden manoeuvres.

explain.short: On a slippery road sudden moves can make the car skid, so drive slowly and smoothly.
explain.rule: The sign warns that the road surface can become slippery and the tyres can lose grip. Slow down and avoid sudden manoeuvres.
explain.trap: 'brusche manovre' (sudden manoeuvres) are what you must avoid: correct.

sceneParams.caption: Moderate speed, no sudden moves

q19278.en: The sign shown warns of a narrowing.

explain.short: A narrowing has a sign with two lines getting closer; this one shows a skidding car.
explain.rule: The sign warns that the road surface can become slippery and the tyres can lose grip. Slow down and avoid sudden manoeuvres.
explain.trap: 'strettoia' (narrowing) is a different danger sign.

sceneParams.caption: Slippery road, not a narrowing

q19279.en: The sign shown warns that you may skid because of strong side wind.

explain.short: Side wind has its own sign with a windsock; this one is about a slippery surface.
explain.rule: The sign warns that the road surface can become slippery and the tyres can lose grip. Slow down and avoid sudden manoeuvres.
explain.trap: 'forte vento laterale' (strong side wind) is a different danger sign.

sceneParams.caption: Slippery surface, not side wind

q19280.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road where tyre grip increases.

explain.short: On a slippery road the grip goes DOWN, not up.
explain.rule: The sign warns that the road surface can become slippery and the tyres can lose grip. Slow down and avoid sudden manoeuvres.
explain.trap: 'aumenta' (increases) is the trap word: grip decreases.

sceneParams.caption: Grip decreases, it does not increase

q19281.en: The sign shown warns that on that road the braking space decreases.

explain.short: With less grip, the car needs MORE space to stop, not less.
explain.rule: The sign warns that the road surface can become slippery and the tyres can lose grip. Slow down and avoid sudden manoeuvres.
explain.trap: 'diminuisce' (decreases) is wrong: the braking space gets longer.

sceneParams.caption: Braking space gets longer, not shorter

q19282.en: The sign shown invites you to reduce the safety distance.

explain.short: On a slippery road you need more space to stop, so you must INCREASE the safety distance.
explain.rule: The sign warns that the road surface can become slippery and the tyres can lose grip. Slow down and avoid sudden manoeuvres.
explain.trap: 'diminuire' (reduce) is the trap: the distance must grow.

sceneParams.caption: Increase the safety distance

q19283.en: The sign shown warns of a road with many bends.

explain.short: The wavy lines are skid marks of the tyres, not a road with bends.
explain.rule: The sign warns that the road surface can become slippery and the tyres can lose grip. Slow down and avoid sudden manoeuvres.
explain.trap: 'molte curve' (many bends) misreads the wavy tracks; bends have their own signs.

sceneParams.caption: Skid marks, not many bends

q19284.en: The sign shown warns of a track for testing tyre grip.

explain.short: It warns of a public road that can be slippery, not of a test track.
explain.rule: The sign warns that the road surface can become slippery and the tyres can lose grip. Slow down and avoid sudden manoeuvres.
explain.trap: 'pista per la prova' (test track) is invented; the sign is about danger on normal roads.

sceneParams.caption: Slippery road, not a test track

q19285.en: Where the sign shown is placed, in case of rain you must moderate your speed and avoid sudden braking.

explain.short: Sudden braking on a wet, slippery road can lock the wheels and make you skid.
explain.rule: On a slippery road, in rain or ice, slow down and do everything gently: no sudden braking, accelerating or steering. Braking and safety distances get longer.
explain.trap: 'brusche frenate' (sudden braking) are to be avoided: correct.

sceneParams.caption: Rain: slow down, no sudden braking

q19286.en: Where the sign shown is placed, in case of ice you must moderate your speed and avoid sudden acceleration.

explain.short: On ice a sudden acceleration makes the wheels spin and the car can slide.
explain.rule: On a slippery road, in rain or ice, slow down and do everything gently: no sudden braking, accelerating or steering. Braking and safety distances get longer.
explain.trap: 'brusche accelerate' (sudden acceleration) are to be avoided: correct.

sceneParams.caption: Ice: slow down, no sudden acceleration

q19287.en: Where the sign shown is placed, in case of rain you must moderate your speed and avoid sudden steering.

explain.short: Sudden steering on a wet road can make the car skid out of its line.
explain.rule: On a slippery road, in rain or ice, slow down and do everything gently: no sudden braking, accelerating or steering. Braking and safety distances get longer.
explain.trap: 'brusche sterzate' (sudden steering) are to be avoided: correct.

sceneParams.caption: Rain: slow down, no sudden steering

q19288.en: Where the sign shown is placed, in case of ice you must moderate your speed and remember that the safety distance increases.

explain.short: On ice you need much more space to stop, so the safety distance must be longer.
explain.rule: On a slippery road, in rain or ice, slow down and do everything gently: no sudden braking, accelerating or steering. Braking and safety distances get longer.
explain.trap: 'aumenta' (increases) is right here: the distance gets longer.

sceneParams.caption: Ice: safety distance gets longer

q19289.en: Where the sign shown is placed, you must keep in mind that the braking distance decreases in case of rain.

explain.short: On a wet road the tyres grip less, so the braking distance gets LONGER.
explain.rule: On a slippery road, in rain or ice, slow down and do everything gently: no sudden braking, accelerating or steering. Braking and safety distances get longer.
explain.trap: 'diminuisce' (decreases) is the trap: it increases.

sceneParams.caption: Rain: braking distance gets longer

q19290.en: Where the sign shown is placed, in case of rain you must reduce the distance from the vehicle ahead.

explain.short: In rain you need more space to stop, so you must INCREASE the distance from the car ahead.
explain.rule: On a slippery road, in rain or ice, slow down and do everything gently: no sudden braking, accelerating or steering. Braking and safety distances get longer.
explain.trap: 'diminuire la distanza' (reduce the distance) is the opposite of the right behaviour.

sceneParams.caption: Rain: keep more distance, not less

q19291.en: Where the sign shown is placed, you must accelerate sharply in case of rain.

explain.short: Sharp acceleration on a wet road makes the wheels spin: you must avoid it.
explain.rule: On a slippery road, in rain or ice, slow down and do everything gently: no sudden braking, accelerating or steering. Braking and safety distances get longer.
explain.trap: 'accelerare bruscamente' (accelerate sharply) is exactly what to avoid.

sceneParams.caption: Rain: never accelerate sharply

q19292.en: Where the sign shown is placed, overtaking is always forbidden when it rains.

explain.short: The sign is only a warning; overtaking is allowed if it is safe and not forbidden by other signs.
explain.rule: On a slippery road, in rain or ice, slow down and do everything gently: no sudden braking, accelerating or steering. Braking and safety distances get longer.
explain.trap: 'sempre vietato' (always forbidden) is too absolute: this sign forbids nothing.

sceneParams.caption: Warning only, overtaking not always banned

q19293.en: Where the sign shown is placed, you must brake sharply in case of ice.

explain.short: Sharp braking on ice locks the wheels and the car slides: you must avoid it.
explain.rule: On a slippery road, in rain or ice, slow down and do everything gently: no sudden braking, accelerating or steering. Braking and safety distances get longer.
explain.trap: 'frenare bruscamente' (brake sharply) is exactly what to avoid.

sceneParams.caption: Ice: never brake sharply

q19294.en: The sign shown forbids transit to vehicles with wheels dirty with mud.

explain.short: It is a danger sign that warns of a slippery road; it forbids nobody.
explain.rule: On a slippery road, in rain or ice, slow down and do everything gently: no sudden braking, accelerating or steering. Braking and safety distances get longer.
explain.trap: 'vieta il transito' (forbids transit) is a prohibition; a danger sign only warns.

sceneParams.caption: Warning, not a ban for muddy vehicles

q19295.en: Where the sign shown is placed, you must fit snow chains.

explain.short: The sign warns of a slippery road; snow chains are required only by a different, round blue sign.
explain.rule: On a slippery road, in rain or ice, slow down and do everything gently: no sudden braking, accelerating or steering. Braking and safety distances get longer.
explain.trap: 'montare le catene' (fit snow chains) is not required by a danger sign.

sceneParams.caption: Slippery road, chains not required

q19296.en: The sign shown can warn of a school attended by children nearby.

explain.short: A school is a typical place where many children cross and walk: the sign can warn of it.
explain.rule: The sign warns of places where children are often present, like schools, playgrounds and gardens. Slow down and watch out for sudden moves.
explain.trap: 'può' (can) makes it one of the possible places: correct.

sceneParams.caption: A school nearby: children ahead

q19297.en: The sign shown can be placed near a playground used by children.

explain.short: Playgrounds are places full of children, so the sign can be placed nearby.
explain.rule: The sign warns of places where children are often present, like schools, playgrounds and gardens. Slow down and watch out for sudden moves.
explain.trap: 'campo da gioco' (playground) is one of the typical places: correct.

sceneParams.caption: Playground nearby: children ahead

q19298.en: The sign shown warns of places used by young children.

explain.short: 'Fanciulli' is an old word for children: the sign warns of places where they gather.
explain.rule: The sign warns of places where children are often present, like schools, playgrounds and gardens. Slow down and watch out for sudden moves.
explain.trap: 'fanciulli' (young children) is just a formal word for 'bambini'.

sceneParams.caption: Places used by children ahead

q19299.en: The sign shown is a danger sign.

explain.short: It is a triangle with a red border: the shape of danger signs.
explain.rule: The sign warns of places where children are often present, like schools, playgrounds and gardens. Slow down and watch out for sudden moves.
explain.trap: 'segnale di pericolo' (danger sign): every red-edged triangle pointing up is one.

sceneParams.caption: Red-edged triangle = danger sign

q19300.en: The sign shown can be placed near public gardens used by children.

explain.short: Public gardens are full of children playing, so the sign can be placed nearby.
explain.rule: The sign warns of places where children are often present, like schools, playgrounds and gardens. Slow down and watch out for sudden moves.
explain.trap: 'giardini pubblici' (public gardens) are one of the typical places: correct.

sceneParams.caption: Public gardens: children ahead

q19301.en: The sign shown invites you to drive at a moderate speed.

explain.short: Children can appear suddenly, so you must drive slowly to stop in time.
explain.rule: The sign warns of places where children are often present, like schools, playgrounds and gardens. Slow down and watch out for sudden moves.
explain.trap: 'velocità moderata' (moderate speed) is the right behaviour.

sceneParams.caption: Children: drive at moderate speed

q19302.en: The sign shown invites you to take into account possible careless behaviour by children.

explain.short: Children can run into the road without looking: the driver must expect it.
explain.rule: The sign warns of places where children are often present, like schools, playgrounds and gardens. Slow down and watch out for sudden moves.
explain.trap: 'comportamenti imprudenti' (careless behaviour) is what you must expect: correct.

sceneParams.caption: Expect careless moves by children

q19303.en: The sign shown forbids transit to unaccompanied children.

explain.short: It is a danger sign for drivers; it forbids nothing, least of all to children.
explain.rule: The sign warns of places where children are often present, like schools, playgrounds and gardens. Slow down and watch out for sudden moves.
explain.trap: 'vieta il transito' (forbids transit) is a prohibition; a danger sign only warns.

sceneParams.caption: Warning for drivers, bans nobody

q19304.en: The sign shown warns of a pedestrian crossing.

explain.short: A pedestrian crossing has its own sign with a person on stripes; this one shows children.
explain.rule: The sign warns of places where children are often present, like schools, playgrounds and gardens. Slow down and watch out for sudden moves.
explain.trap: 'attraversamento pedonale' (pedestrian crossing) is a different danger sign.

sceneParams.caption: Children, not a pedestrian crossing

q19305.en: The sign shown indicates the end of an avenue reserved for children.

explain.short: It is a danger sign about children nearby; there is no 'avenue for children' and no 'end'.
explain.rule: The sign warns of places where children are often present, like schools, playgrounds and gardens. Slow down and watch out for sudden moves.
explain.trap: 'fine di un viale' (end of an avenue) is invented.

sceneParams.caption: Children ahead, not end of an avenue

q19306.en: The sign shown warns of a pedestrian path.

explain.short: A pedestrian path is shown by a round blue sign; this triangle warns of children.
explain.rule: The sign warns of places where children are often present, like schools, playgrounds and gardens. Slow down and watch out for sudden moves.
explain.trap: 'percorso pedonale' (pedestrian path) is a different, blue sign.

sceneParams.caption: Children, not a pedestrian path

q19307.en: The sign shown forbids transit to motor vehicles at the time children leave school.

explain.short: A danger sign does not forbid traffic; it asks you to be careful at all times.
explain.rule: The sign warns of places where children are often present, like schools, playgrounds and gardens. Slow down and watch out for sudden moves.
explain.trap: 'vieta il transito' (forbids transit) is a prohibition; this sign only warns.

sceneParams.caption: Warning only, no time ban

q19308.en: The sign shown indicates a school bus stop.

explain.short: A bus stop has its own markings and signs; this triangle warns of children nearby.
explain.rule: The sign warns of places where children are often present, like schools, playgrounds and gardens. Slow down and watch out for sudden moves.
explain.trap: 'fermata di uno scuolabus' (school bus stop) is not the meaning of this sign.

sceneParams.caption: Children ahead, not a school bus stop

q19309.en: The sign shown is placed on the back of the school bus.

explain.short: This is a road sign on a pole near schools and gardens, not a sign on a bus.
explain.rule: The sign warns of places where children are often present, like schools, playgrounds and gardens. Slow down and watch out for sudden moves.
explain.trap: 'parte posteriore dello scuolabus' (back of the school bus) is the wrong place.

sceneParams.caption: Road sign on a pole, not on a bus

q19310.en: Where the sign shown is placed, you must pay special attention because children may be present.

explain.short: The sign tells you children may be near, so you must be extra careful.
explain.rule: Children are unpredictable, even on the pavement: slow down and pay special attention. Never overtake a car that stopped to let children cross.
explain.trap: 'particolare attenzione' (special attention) is the right attitude.

sceneParams.caption: Special attention: children may be near

q19311.en: Where the sign shown is placed, you must moderate your speed and pay attention to children even if they are on the pavement.

explain.short: A child on the pavement can run into the road at any moment, so you watch them too.
explain.rule: Children are unpredictable, even on the pavement: slow down and pay special attention. Never overtake a car that stopped to let children cross.
explain.trap: 'anche se' (even if) is right: children on the pavement count too.

sceneParams.caption: Watch children on the pavement too

q19312.en: Where the sign shown is placed, you must pay special attention to the unpredictable movements of children.

explain.short: Children can change direction or run suddenly: the driver must expect it.
explain.rule: Children are unpredictable, even on the pavement: slow down and pay special attention. Never overtake a car that stopped to let children cross.
explain.trap: 'movimenti imprevedibili' (unpredictable movements) is what you must watch for.

sceneParams.caption: Expect unpredictable moves

q19313.en: Where the sign shown is placed, it is forbidden to overtake vehicles that have stopped to let children cross.

explain.short: A child could be crossing in front of the stopped car, hidden from you: overtaking it is forbidden.
explain.rule: Children are unpredictable, even on the pavement: slow down and pay special attention. Never overtake a car that stopped to let children cross.
explain.trap: 'vietato sorpassare' (forbidden to overtake) is correct here: the stopped car hides the children.

sceneParams.caption: Don't pass a car stopped for children

q19314.en: Where the sign shown is placed, you must watch out for children on the carriageway and not for those on the pavement.

explain.short: Children on the pavement can run into the road too, so you must watch them as well.
explain.rule: Children are unpredictable, even on the pavement: slow down and pay special attention. Never overtake a car that stopped to let children cross.
explain.trap: 'e non a quelli sul marciapiede' (and not those on the pavement) is the wrong part.

sceneParams.caption: Watch children on the pavement too

q19315.en: Where the sign shown is placed, driving through is forbidden when children leave school.

explain.short: A danger sign does not ban traffic; it asks you to slow down and be careful.
explain.rule: Children are unpredictable, even on the pavement: slow down and pay special attention. Never overtake a car that stopped to let children cross.
explain.trap: 'vietato transitare' (forbidden to drive through) is a prohibition this sign does not give.

sceneParams.caption: Warning only, no ban at school times

q19316.en: Where the sign shown is placed, it is forbidden to exceed 30 km/h.

explain.short: The sign asks for a moderate speed but sets no fixed number; a limit needs a separate round sign.
explain.rule: Children are unpredictable, even on the pavement: slow down and pay special attention. Never overtake a car that stopped to let children cross.
explain.trap: '30 km/h' is an invented number: a danger sign gives no speed limit.

sceneParams.caption: Moderate speed, but no fixed 30 limit

q19317.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road where domestic animals are likely to cross.

explain.short: The cow in the triangle means farm animals may cross the road.
explain.rule: The sign warns that farm animals may be on the road or crossing it. Slow down, and stop if the animals are frightened or do not move.
explain.trap: 'animali domestici' (domestic, farm animals) matches the cow in the picture.

sceneParams.caption: Farm animals may cross ahead

q19318.en: The sign shown requires you to slow down or stop if the animals on the road show signs of fear.

explain.short: Frightened animals can move suddenly, so you slow down or stop.
explain.rule: The sign warns that farm animals may be on the road or crossing it. Slow down, and stop if the animals are frightened or do not move.
explain.trap: 'danno segno di spavento' (show signs of fear) is the condition for slowing or stopping.

sceneParams.caption: Frightened animals: slow down or stop

q19319.en: The sign shown requires you to slow down or stop if the animals on the road do not move.

explain.short: If the animals stay on the road, you must slow down or wait until they move.
explain.rule: The sign warns that farm animals may be on the road or crossing it. Slow down, and stop if the animals are frightened or do not move.
explain.trap: 'non si spostano' (do not move) is the condition for slowing or stopping.

sceneParams.caption: Animals don't move: slow down or stop

q19320.en: The sign shown warns that you may find wandering domestic animals on the road.

explain.short: Farm animals may walk freely on the road: this is what the sign warns of.
explain.rule: The sign warns that farm animals may be on the road or crossing it. Slow down, and stop if the animals are frightened or do not move.
explain.trap: 'vaganti' (wandering) is part of the official name of the sign.

sceneParams.caption: Wandering farm animals possible

q19321.en: The sign shown invites you to pay attention because domestic animals are likely to be on the carriageway.

explain.short: Animals may be on the road, so the driver must be careful.
explain.rule: The sign warns that farm animals may be on the road or crossing it. Slow down, and stop if the animals are frightened or do not move.
explain.trap: 'invita a fare attenzione' (invites you to be careful) is right for a danger sign.

sceneParams.caption: Be careful: animals on the road

q19322.en: Where the sign shown is placed, it is compulsory to use the horn repeatedly to drive the animals away.

explain.short: Repeated horn use can frighten the animals and make them move suddenly; you slow down or stop instead.
explain.rule: The sign warns that farm animals may be on the road or crossing it. Slow down, and stop if the animals are frightened or do not move.
explain.trap: 'obbligatorio usare ripetutamente' (compulsory to use repeatedly) is wrong: no such duty.

sceneParams.caption: Slow down; no repeated horn

q19323.en: The sign shown warns of an area reserved for grazing where motor vehicles are forbidden.

explain.short: It is a danger sign: it warns of animals, but it does not forbid any vehicle.
explain.rule: The sign warns that farm animals may be on the road or crossing it. Slow down, and stop if the animals are frightened or do not move.
explain.trap: 'divieto di transito' (ban on transit) is a prohibition this sign does not give.

sceneParams.caption: Animals ahead, no ban on vehicles

q19324.en: The sign shown warns of a road reserved for domestic animals.

explain.short: The road is for normal traffic; the sign only warns that animals may be on it.
explain.rule: The sign warns that farm animals may be on the road or crossing it. Slow down, and stop if the animals are frightened or do not move.
explain.trap: 'riservata' (reserved) is wrong: the road is not only for animals.

sceneParams.caption: Normal road, animals may be on it

q19325.en: The sign shown warns of animal-drawn vehicles.

explain.short: The cow means loose farm animals, not carts pulled by animals.
explain.rule: The sign warns that farm animals may be on the road or crossing it. Slow down, and stop if the animals are frightened or do not move.
explain.trap: 'veicoli a trazione animale' (animal-drawn vehicles) is a different meaning.

sceneParams.caption: Loose animals, not animal-drawn carts

q19326.en: The sign shown warns of a farm in open countryside.

explain.short: It warns of animals on the road, not of a farm building.
explain.rule: The sign warns that farm animals may be on the road or crossing it. Slow down, and stop if the animals are frightened or do not move.
explain.trap: 'fattoria' (farm) is invented: the sign is about the animals.

sceneParams.caption: Animals on the road, not a farm
